key_insight: Layer-wise generalizations of Barron norms characterize expected optimal discretization errors when converting infinite-width layers into finite neural networks.
engineering_relevance: The theory offers a framework for analyzing finite-network approximation error by separating layer selection from discretization.
method: Select optimal infinite-width limits for each layer.
Optimally discretize all layers into a finite network.
Analyze local minima through an equidistribution principle.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical characterizations of expected discretization error and local minima, but no datasets or empirical benchmarks.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish a practical algorithm for attaining the optimal discretizations.
paper_title: Barron Smoothness for Layers in Deep Neural Networks
